priceDisplay.note: Honda Atlas cut the HR-V e:HEV from PKR 10,369,000 to PKR 9,299,000 after SRO 1525(I)/2026, for orders invoiced from 25 Sept 2026; Honda says the price applies 'for a limited time and limited stocks' (also TechJuice, PakNEV). '(promo)' is not an allowed suffix.

acceleration.note: PakNEV: 0–100 km/h 10.7 s (Honda Atlas does not publish one).

notes.value: Third-generation HR-V with Honda's two-motor e:HEV hybrid, assembled and sold by Honda Atlas as the top HR-V version (single trim). Honda Atlas brochure: 1,498 cc DOHC i-VTEC engine 78 kW (105 hp) / 127 Nm, drive motor 96 kW (131 PS) / 253 Nm, e-CVT, lithium-ion battery, 4,361 × 1,790 × 1,591 mm, 2,610 mm wheelbase, 196 mm ground clearance, 5 seats, 40 L tank, 18-inch wheels; power 129 is the motor's output. PakNEV gives 0–100 km/h 10.7 s, 170 km/h, 319 L boot and 1,380 kg (not published by Honda Atlas; PakNEV lists the length as 4,385 mm). Equipment: 6 airbags, Honda Sensing (collision mitigation braking, lane keep assist, road departure mitigation, adaptive cruise, auto high beam, lead car departure notification), 9-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, 7-inch digital cluster, perforated leather seats, wireless charger, power tailgate with kick sensor; no sunroof and no 360° camera (PakWheels first look). Price: launched at PKR 8,999,000 (July 2025), raised to PKR 10,369,000 on 1 July 2026 when the hybrid sales-tax concession lapsed, cut to PKR 9,299,000 from 25 Sept 2026 after SRO 1525(I)/2026, offered by Honda for a limited time and on limited stock. Sources: Honda Atlas brochure, ProPakistani (25 Sept 2026), TechJuice, PakNEV, PakWheels.

notes.value: A self-charging full hybrid (no plug), assembled in Pakistan by Indus Motor Company. Toyota Indus spec sheet: 1,798 cc 2ZR-FXE engine 72 kW / 142 Nm plus a 53 kW / 163 Nm electric motor, e-CVT, EV/Eco/Power modes, 4,460 × 1,825 × 1,620 mm, 2,640 mm wheelbase, 161 mm ground clearance, 36 L tank, 17-inch alloys, 7 airbags. Toyota Indus does not publish system output; PakNEV lists 97 hp (the engine alone), a 1.3 kWh battery, 436 L boot, 1,385 kg and 180 km/h. Two grades: HEV PKR 9,299,000 (7-inch screen, fabric seats, manual seats) and HEV X PKR 9,729,000 (adds 9-inch screen, leather seats, powered driver seat, moonroof, blind spot monitor, rear cross-traffic alert, power tailgate with kick sensor, auto-dimming mirror, rain-sensing wipers). Prices were 9,849,000 and 10,299,000 from 1 July 2026 and fell after SRO 1525(I)/2026 (13 Sept 2026). Warranty: Toyota Indus quotes 6 years / 160,000 km on the hybrid battery (PakNEV says 8 years). Sources: Toyota Indus Corolla Cross page and spec sheet, PakNEV, PakWheels.

notes.value: Small Chinese-designed electric hatchback sold by Eco-Green Motors (Yousuf Dewan Companies) and assembled by Dewan Farooque Motors at Sujawal; deliveries since late 2024. VE 2.0 is the 200 km version: 18.5 kWh ternary lithium battery, 200 km CLTC (PakNEV estimates 146 km real-world), 30 kW (40 hp) / 84 Nm, 100 km/h, 3.3 kW on-board charger (Type 2), about 7 h to full; 3,517 × 1,495 × 1,660 mm, 2,495 mm wheelbase, 130 mm ground clearance, 15-inch alloys; PakNEV lists 150 L boot and 950 kg. Equipment: two airbags, ABS/EBD, TPMS, ISOFIX, reversing camera and rear sensors, 10.25-inch Android touchscreen, 5-inch cluster, Eco/Sport modes. Seats: PakWheels says 5, PakNEV 4. The VE 3.0 (29.9 kWh LFP, 300 km CLTC, 35 kW) costs PKR 4,399,000. Price: launched at PKR 3,999,000 (2024), later 4,199,000, cut to PKR 3,599,000 in Dec 2025 as a limited-time offer that is still the listed price in Nov 2026. Sources: PakWheels, PakNEV, ProPakistani, Bol News.

notes.value: Nora's E-30 is a small four-seat electric city car (quadricycle class) imported from China; Nora also sells the larger NEO (Rs 2,499,999) and METRO (Rs 2,899,999). E-30 versions (Oct 2026, prices effective 20 Oct 2026, ex-warehouse Karachi, provisional and excluding GST per Gari.pk): ECO 9.1 kWh LFP, 120 km, Rs 1,899,999; ECO REEV 9.1 kWh with a petrol range extender, 250 km, Rs 2,049,999; ECO+ 15.1 kWh, 180 km, Rs 2,099,999; ECO+ REEV 15.1 kWh with range extender, 300 km, Rs 2,249,999 (no test standard given). 4 kW motor (5 hp per PakNEV), RWD, 65 km/h top speed (PakWheels; PakNEV says 60), 2.2 kW AC charging, 6–8 h to full; 2,900 × 1,450 × 1,600 mm, 1,900 mm wheelbase, 150 mm ground clearance; 580 kg is from the Nov 2025 catalogue. The range extender is a small petrol generator with a 3 L tank (PakWheels said 70 cc in March 2026, PakNEV says 250 cc). Equipment: Android touchscreen with Bluetooth, reversing camera, AC/heater, remote central locking, power windows, roof rails, alloy wheels. Earlier prices (March 2026): Eco 1,889,000, Eco+ 2,099,000, EcoX 2,299,000. Sources: ProPakistani (21 Oct 2026), Gari.pk, PakNEV, PakWheels.
